hypothesis: Time derivatives and curvature of 128/256/512/1024-conflict solver telemetry improve out-of-sample prediction of forced restartint=50 vs single 1024-conflict state on unseen formula SHA IDs.
training_phase: Only newly generated 60 random3_development formulas, three native monitor/forced50/r16 runs per CNF; freeze both model coefficients before any test job.
test_phase: 60 unseen random3_test formula SHA IDs used once as primary; 20 community3_test transfer separately. 20 community3_development exploratory only, excluded from training.
outcome: clip(log(PAR2_monitor/PAR2_force2048_50), -1.5, +1.5) with 3 paired repetitions per formula
baseline: Predict development label mean; compare absolute/squared errors.
feature_missing: Only formulas reaching 1024 conflicts in all 3 r16 live runs enter training and primary head-to-head error metric; report coverage and abstention, use zero predicted gain when missing.
validation_metrics: Primary on 60 random3_test: same eligible subset, paired test MSE snapshot minus trajectory, formula bootstrap 95% CI with 4000 draws; positive means trajectory better
secondary paired MAE delta and Spearman correlations of predicted vs observed log-time ratio
off-policy, *not live*, forecast-selected restarts at fixed frozen threshold predicted log gain > log(1.05), and resulting PAR2 measured from separately run forced50 arm
number of extreme beneficial formulas missed and >2x harmful interventions on 60 primary formulas
separate community3_test transfer, no test tuning
guardrails: No R18/R17 test samples recycled as fresh holdout
Snapshot/trajectory use identical formulas and identical ridge penalty (lambda 30)
No model sees primary random3_test or community3_test labels during fitting
No policy selection/parameter fitting after inspecting test results
Off-policy prediction is not a live R19 solver or causal proof
Synthetic random3/community3 only, NOT official competition problems
SAT witness checking; independent UNSAT certificates not available
If freeze job fails, never run holdout jobs
